metadata.data_lineage_note: A publicly accessible KGIS-derived mapping mirror was used only as bulk transport/staging because the official K-GIS ASP.NET master-table export could not be programmatically retrieved here. Official K-GIS/Bhoomi/district sources remain the authority. Unsupported discrepancies were not silently corrected or invented.

known_conflicts_and_exceptions.detail: Current Bidar District Administration reports 635 villages; active staging master yields 634. Taluk-level comparison localizes the one-record difference to Basavakalyan (official 97 vs staging 96). No village name was invented to close the gap.

Official Bengaluru South district pages confirm the 23-05-2025 rename from Ramanagara and identify Harohalli as a taluk separated in 2024, while a current District-at-a-Glance page reports 4 taluks/18 hoblies/823 villages. Another current district page lists 5 taluks including Harohalli. Master retains 5 taluks from the current administrative grouping; conflict is documented.

341 staging rows carry non-10-character codes (predominantly 16-digit census-style identifiers). Some labels are non-administrative features such as submerged/reservoir records. They are retained in audit.unresolved_source_records and excluded from dropdown master pending authoritative classification.

Live K-GIS Master Tables explicitly publish district, taluk, hobli, village, Bhoomi and LGD code fields, but the dynamic export could not be programmatically retrieved in this execution environment. District/taluk/hobli code values are therefore null rather than inferred. Village codes are retained only where the staging KGIS mapping supplied a single unambiguous code.

K-GIS portal terms/copyright text restrict commercial use and require revalidation of derived geospatial information. Embedding government master data in a commercial Trust-AI build should be cleared with KSRSAC/GoK before production distribution.
